qualityReasoning: The three testimonial cards share an identical, fairly long utility-class string ("p-4 rounded-lg shadow-md flex flex-col gap-2", "w-12 h-12 rounded-full", "text-sm text-gray-600") copy-pasted verbatim across all three instances with no extraction into a component class or shared recipe — exactly the anti-pattern the rubric penalizes.
